messages:
leah_oncall: heads up — sudden 5xx spike on hosted inference starting ~1705556600, still rising. dashboards: https://redwood.internal/d/ops/latency?from=now-30m

deploy-bot: deploy finished: inference-gateway v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 (canary=10%). CI: #7891

sam_support: getting multiple support tickets: clients seeing timeouts + 502s on generate endpoint. affected customer IDs: C-442, C-986. Tickets attached.

mike_eng-sre: canary id / rollout config? any feature flags toggled with this push?

leah_oncall: canary rollout started with config: feature.routing.variant=v2, canary_slice=10% — but I saw traffic to v2 at ~60% in the metrics. investigating selector mismatch.

erin_platform: seeing gateway logs with repeated `upstream read timeout` and `auth: token parse error` around the same time. sample from gateway stderr:
```
2024-11-03T14:23:12Z gateway ERROR upstream read timeout: client=10.2.0.45 req=/v1/generate ctx=abc123
2024-11-03T14:23:13Z auth WARN token parse error: missing kid header
2024-11-03T14:23:14Z gateway ERROR 502 returning upstream failure
```

javier_product: customers on premium are calling. can we roll back the canary until we know root cause? :phone: @mike_eng-sre

mike_eng-sre: agree. preparing rollback now. command I will run:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway --to-revision=124
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/inference-gateway
```

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by mike_eng-sre (runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-5xx)

pagerduty_bot: INC-2024-331: Error rate above threshold (>5% 5xx) — escalation notified (oncall: leah_oncall).

leah_oncall: repro steps I ran from our edge region: 
1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -XPOST https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -v
response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway, body: {"error":"upstream timeout"}

sam_support: customers also reporting unexpected billing consumption spikes in same window. holding off credits until we confirm scope, but prepping courtesy credits.

erin_platform: found probable config drift: the routing selector in config-service was pushed as:
```
route:
  selector: "region=us"
  // expected: "region=us && version=v2"
  weight: 10
```
Missing `version` qualifier meant the selector matched broader pool and some nodes returned a new kernel-path handling auth differently -> token parse failures. tagging config-service owner.

mike_eng-sre: rollback completed, status: green. `kubectl rollout status` reported success at 1705557200. 5xx rate down to baseline per dashboard.

leah_oncall: monitoring — error-rate back to normal but will keep 15-min cadence for next 2 hours. syncing with support for credits and customer comms.

javier_product: please add incident note in tracker with root cause = config selector omission + canary traffic misrouting. request: tighter preflight check for selector syntax.

mike_eng-sre: adding temporary guard in rollout pipeline to validate selector includes version when feature.routing.* is set. follow-up PR incoming.

sam_support: will send customer update template and open credit requests for impacted accounts C-442, C-986.

leah_oncall: thanks team. filing for postmortem and will schedule a quick war room to capture timeline. :white_check_mark:
